name: Parameters panel in the material graph, and a Number node that takes a wire

comments.text: Dean 2026-11-27: can't plug a variable into a material node's inputs (scalar value etc.). The material graph's left column is empty because script variables are hidden for materials. Plan: a Parameters panel listing the graph's mat_param names with Get (adds a parameter node to wire into any input) and an add row (name, default). mat_scalar takes a wired number as well as a typed one.
